description: Curated collection of free, open-access mathematics textbooks. List compiled from the AIM Open Textbook Initiative, Open Textbook Library, PreTeXt Gallery, and community recommendations.

entries.title: College Algebra 2e
entries.subject: algebra
entries.description: Comprehensive college algebra textbook covering linear equations, functions, polynomials, exponential and logarithmic functions, trigonometry, and analytic geometry. Part of the OpenStax free textbook series.

entries.title: Calculus Volume 1
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: First of three volumes covering single-variable calculus: limits, derivatives, integration, and applications. Written in the accessible OpenStax style with worked examples and exercises.

entries.title: Calculus Volume 2
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Second of three volumes covering integration techniques, parametric equations, polar coordinates, sequences, series, and differential equations.

entries.title: Calculus Volume 3
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Third of three volumes covering parametric equations, polar coordinates, vectors, functions of several variables, multiple integration, and second-order differential equations.

entries.title: Active Calculus — Single Variable
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: A modern, active-learning approach to single-variable calculus. Free PDF download and interactive HTML version. Designed for an active learning classroom with engaging exercises.

entries.title: Active Calculus — Multivariable
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Continuation of Active Calculus to multivariable functions. Covers vectors, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and vector calculus.

entries.title: CLP-1 Differential Calculus
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: First of three CLP calculus textbooks from UBC. Covers limits, derivatives, and applications. Free PDF and HTML versions available.

entries.title: CLP-2 Integral Calculus
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Second CLP calculus textbook. Covers integration techniques, applications, sequences, and series.

entries.title: CLP-3 Multivariable Calculus
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Third CLP calculus textbook. Covers vectors, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and vector calculus.

entries.title: Calculus
entries.subject: calculus
entries.description: Gilbert Strang's classic calculus textbook, available freely via MIT OpenCourseWare. Covers single variable and multivariable calculus with rich applications.

entries.title: Linear Algebra Done Right
entries.subject: linear-algebra
entries.description: The definitive open linear algebra textbook. Takes a modern, proof-based approach emphasizing linear maps over determinants. Widely adopted at top universities. Free PDF from the author's website.

entries.title: Introduction to Linear Algebra
entries.subject: linear-algebra
entries.description: Gilbert Strang's renowned linear algebra textbook, companion to his MIT OCW lecture series. Applications-focused approach with clear geometric intuition.

entries.title: A First Course in Linear Algebra
entries.subject: linear-algebra
entries.description: A well-organized linear algebra textbook with carefully constructed examples, full exercise sets with solutions, and ~90 Sage examples integrated throughout. Available in PDF and HTML.

entries.title: Linear Algebra
entries.subject: linear-algebra
entries.description: A free, open-source linear algebra textbook covering Gauss's Method, vector spaces, linear maps, determinants, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors. Extensive exercise sets with worked answers.

entries.title: Notes on Diffy Qs: Differential Equations for Engineers
entries.subject: differential-equations
entries.description: A free, open-source textbook for a one- or two-semester first course in ordinary differential equations. Used at many universities with video lecture versions available.

entries.title: Elementary Differential Equations
entries.subject: differential-equations
entries.description: A classic first course in ordinary differential equations, previously published by Brooks/Cole. Free PDF and LaTeX source available. Also available with boundary value problems.

entries.title: Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction
entries.subject: discrete-math
entries.description: A free, open-source textbook for a first or second year undergraduate discrete math course. Features an interactive ebook version. Covers logic, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory, and more.

entries.title: Book of Proof
entries.subject: other
entries.description: An introduction to the standard methods of proving mathematical theorems. Extremely popular for transition-to-proof courses. Covers logic, sets, induction, relations, functions, cardinality, and more.

entries.title: OpenIntro Statistics
entries.subject: statistics
entries.description: A traditional introduction to statistics at the college level. Covers data collection, exploratory data analysis, probability, inference, and regression. Free PDF download.

entries.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning (ISLR)
entries.subject: statistics
entries.description: The definitive introduction to statistical learning and machine learning, with applications in R. Covers linear regression, classification, resampling, tree-based methods, SVM, deep learning, and more. Free PDF from authors.

entries.title: Introduction to Probability
entries.subject: probability
entries.description: A well-established probability textbook covering combinatorial probability, conditional probability, random variables, distributions, limit theorems, and Markov chains.

entries.title: Abstract Algebra: Theory and Applications
entries.subject: other
entries.description: The gold standard open abstract algebra textbook. Covers groups, rings, fields, and Galois theory. Includes Sage integration throughout. Used at many universities nationwide.

entries.title: Basic Analysis: Introduction to Real Analysis
entries.subject: other
entries.description: A free undergraduate real analysis textbook covering the real numbers, sequences, continuity, differentiation, integration, sequences of functions, and metric spaces. Well-organized and readable.

entries.title: Measure, Integration & Real Analysis
entries.subject: other
entries.description: A graduate-level real analysis textbook published via Springer's Open Access program. Covers measure theory, Lebesgue integration, Banach and Hilbert spaces, and more. Reader-friendly style.

entries.title: A First Course in Complex Analysis
entries.subject: other
entries.publisher: San Francisco State University / Binghamton University
entries.description: A one-semester undergraduate complex analysis textbook. Covers complex numbers, analytic functions, integration, series, residues, and conformal maps.

entries.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
entries.subject: other
entries.description: Comprehensive introduction to the mathematical foundations of machine learning. Covers linear algebra, analytic geometry, matrix decompositions, vector calculus, probability, and optimization.

entries.title: Understanding Linear Algebra
entries.subject: linear-algebra
entries.description: A first course in linear algebra emphasizing geometric intuition and conceptual understanding. Built with PreTeXt, with an interactive HTML version and a clean, example-driven exposition. Covers vectors, matrices, linear transformations, eigenvalues, and orthogonality.
